اجتنين (form VIII)
# اِجْتَنَيْنَ (ijtanayna) /id͡ʒ.ta.naj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
# اُجْتُنِينَ (ujtunīna) /ud͡ʒ.tu.niː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
# اِجْتَنِينَ (ijtanīna) /id͡ʒ.ta.niː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
